gaps.sentence: I look forward to ___ your suggestions at the meeting.
I've always wanted ___ how to sail.
I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
gaps.explanation: regret + to-infinitive (formal announcements); regret + -ing = be sorry about the past.

gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: He'd sooner ___ than ask for directions.
gaps.explanation: would sooner + bare infinitive (like would rather): sooner drive.

gaps.sentence: I can't imagine ___ in a tiny village again.
Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.

gaps.sentence: She couldn't resist ___ the last biscuit.
